class.name: SwiftLanguage
class.brief_description: The built-in scripting language for Swift scripts.
class.description: [SwiftLanguage] is the [ScriptLanguage] implementation registered for the [code].swift[/code] extension in builds with the [code]swift[/code] module enabled ([code]module_swift_enabled=yes[/code]). It recognizes [code].swift[/code] files, provides Swift syntax metadata (keywords, comment and string delimiters) to the editor, and delegates compilation and execution to the Swift runtime library through the C ABI bridge in [code]swift_bridge.h[/code].
